core_obligations: Embed: choose an injection of the module into an injective module, using that the category of modules has enough injectives (proof lines 703-706)

Apply Zorn: consider the set of submodules containing the module and essential over it, ordered by inclusion; a union of a totally ordered family is again essential over the module, so a maximal element exists (proof lines 707-712)

Show the maximal element is a hull: injectivity of the maximal element follows from the cited criterion, and the resulting essential extension by an injective module is an injective hull (proof lines 713-715)
proof_roadmap: 由 More on Algebra 的结论，模范畴有足够多内射对象：取嵌入 M ⊂ I，I 内射。
令 S = {M ⊂ E ⊂ I : E 是 M 的本质扩张}，按包含排序；全序子族的并仍是本质扩张（union-essential-extensions）⇒ Zorn 引理给极大元 E。
由 essential-extensions-in-injective 引理，E 内射；于是 M ⊂ E 既是本质扩张又是内射 ⇒ 是注入壳。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the existence of an injective hull for an arbitrary module over a ring (author lemma at source lines 697-700, label lemma-injective-hull). The proof (source lines 702-716) embeds the module into an injective module, applies Zorn's lemma to the family of essential extensions of the module inside that injective module - a family shown to be inductive by stability of essentialness under unions of chains - and concludes that a maximal member is injective by the cited criterion, hence is an injective hull (proof lines 713-715). The Zorn argument inside a fixed injective is the substance. H3.
